name: FiveM (FXServer)
description: Cfx.re multiplayer server for GTA V. Downloads a pinned FXServer artifact from runtime.fivem.net; requires a free Cfx.re license key.

install.command: if [ -f fx.tar.xz ]; then tar -xJf fx.tar.xz && rm fx.tar.xz; else echo 'NOTE: set the FXServer artifact URL variable, then re-run install.'; fi

install.content:
# Generated by Between — extend freely (resources, permissions, convars).
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}"
sv_hostname "{{HOSTNAME}}"
sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}}
sv_licenseKey "{{LICENSE_KEY}}"
set onesync on

variables.label: FXServer artifact URL
variables.description: Copy the latest recommended fx.tar.xz link from runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/ (artifact URLs are build-pinned). Leave empty to skip the download, set it and re-run install to update.

variables.label: Cfx.re license key
variables.description: Free key from portal.cfx.re — the server will not start without one.

notes: The artifact URL must be set before the first install (build-pinned URLs change with every FXServer release). For the standard resource set, clone github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data and copy its resources/ folder into server-data/, then add the usual 'ensure' lines to server.cfg. Changing the port also requires updating both endpoint_add lines in server.cfg. RedM (Red Dead Redemption 2) uses the same FXServer artifacts with sv_enforceGameBuild and RedM resources. The console accepts commands on stdin ('quit' stops the server).
